exec: pm.test('page size and 555 seeded events', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.size).to.eql(12); pm.expect(p.content).to.have.length(12); pm.expect(p.totalElements).to.eql(555); pm.expect(p).to.have.all.keys('content','page','size','totalElements','totalPages','first','last'); });
